notes.title: Trade Tales Update: Shopkeeping Now Revealed!
notes.notes: [h3]We’ve been hard at work polishing the game and the next exciting feature is finally here, selling your hard-earned goods in your very own shop![/h3][p][/p][p]▶ Watch the full preview video here:[/p][previewyoutube="oCXXaD1hjiM;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]In it, you’ll see firsthand how smooth shop management works, including how to spot and handle sneaky shoplifters.[/h3][p][/p][h3]This feature is one of the most highly requested by our community, and we can’t wait for you to try it in action. More surprises are on the way as we build toward our Alpha release this September![/h3][p][/p][h3]As always, thank you all for being part of this journey, keep those wishlists coming, and we’ll see you in the shop soon![/h3]

notes.title: Trade Tales: Special Early Access Starts Now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Trade Tales: Special Early Access Starts Now! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf4/1/16/2728.png"][/img][/b][/p][p]The wait is finally over! Trade Tales is opening its doors for Special Early Access, and you’re invited to be one of the first to explore the cozy world we’ve been building with heart and passion. [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/te9/1/16/1f496.png"][/img][/p][p]Begin your new life in Cloverdale, a peaceful countryside town full of charm and opportunity. Start from a modest plot of land and grow it into your dream farm, run your own shop, and shape a life that’s entirely your own.[/p][previewyoutube="z6WAQyEYfXQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In this special demo, you’ll get a hands-on experience of starting from scratch, tilling the soil and planting seeds, harvesting a variety of crops, catching fish, collecting precious metals and ores in the mines, customizing your land, raising animals and gathering their produce, meeting friendly townsfolk, and discovering plenty more along the way![/p][p][/p][p]By joining early, you’ll unlock:[/p][p][img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t33/1/16/2705.png"][/img] Your name featured in the game credits[/p][p][img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t33/1/16/2705.png"][/img] Access to exclusive backer-only items[/p][p][img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t33/1/16/2705.png"][/img] A chance to help shape the future of the game with your feedback[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t37/1/16/2709.png"][/img] If you’d like to join the special early access, just send us a message on our official Facebook page and we’ll get you set up.
👉 [url="https://www.facebook.com/tradetalesgame"]Facebook Page Link here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t5c/1/16/1f5d3.png"][/img] Mark your calendars: Trade Tales will be playable starting [b]July 10, 2025![/b][/p][p]Get ready to plant, trade, explore, and thrive, we can't wait to see what you’ll create in Cloverdale! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t77/1/16/1f3e1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A Fresh Look: Character Redesign Update!
notes.notes:
[b]✨ We hear you, and we’re listening! ✨[/b]
Your feedback on the character designs in our trailer has been invaluable, and we can’t thank you enough for sharing your thoughts. 💖

We’ve gone back to the drawing board and redesigned the body proportions to make them feel more natural while still maintaining the stylized art style you love.  This change reflects our dedication to creating a game that resonates with our players!
Your input is the heart of what makes Trade Tales special, and we’re committed to continuing to improve based on your requests and ideas. 🎮

Together, we’re shaping something truly unique. 🌟

Take a look at the updated designs, and let us know what you think! Your voice matters. 🥰

notes.title: 🎉 Kickstarter Campaign Launching This July 2024! 🚀
notes.notes:
[h3]Kickstarter Campaign Launching This July 2024! [/h3]
We're thrilled to announce the launch of our Kickstarter campaign for "Trade Tales" this July 2, 2024! 📅This is your chance to dive into the enchanting world of "Trade Tales" before anyone else and be a part of shaping its journey.

[h3]Get Early Access and Unlock Exclusive Rewards!✨[/h3]
By supporting our Kickstarter, you'll not only gain early access to "Trade Tales" but also unlock a treasure trove of exclusive rewards that are only available during the campaign. These include:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790246/26315f747c12509c821cd1d53293cc14240efaaa.jpg[/img]
[b]🎮Alpha Access:[/b] Be among the first to play "Trade Tales" with alpha access, the earliest version of the game available. Test new features, provide feedback, and experience content before it's released to the public. This exclusive opportunity is only available for a limited time during this campaign!

[b]👕Exclusive Wearables:[/b] Dress your character in adorable and unique outfits that showcase your status as a campaign backer.

[b]🏠Special Furniture:[/b] Decorate your in-game space with exclusive and beautifully crafted furniture pieces.

[b]🚗Custom Vehicles: [/b]Travel through the world of "Trade Tales" in style with exclusive vehicles only available during this campaign.

[b]😻Charming Pets:[/b] Adopt unique delightful pets that will accompany you on your adventures and bring joy to your journey.

[b]📝Your Name in Credits:[/b] Leave your mark on "Trade Tales" by having your name featured in the game's credits.

[b]👫Create Your Own Dateable NPC:[/b] Design and name a character that players can interact with romantically within "Trade Tales."

[b]📢Sponsorship Opportunity:[/b] Become a sponsor and have your brand prominently displayed on billboards within one of the bustling cities of "Trade Tales."


[h3]Why Support Us?[/h3]
Your support is crucial in helping us expand "Trade Tales" with additional content, enhance its features, and ensure a rich and immersive experience for all players. As an early backer, your feedback will play a pivotal role in shaping the game's development.

[h3]Join Our Community![/h3]
Join a passionate community of backers who share your love for "Trade Tales." Together, we'll embark on an adventure filled with exploration, discovery, and friendship.

Discord: https://discord.gg/nRmFfHUrnX                  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tradetalesgame


[h3]Don't Miss Out![/h3]
Save the date for July 2, 2024 and be ready to support "Trade Tales" on Kickstarter. Your participation not only unlocks exclusive rewards but also helps us bring this Dream game to life. Join us in making "Trade Tales" an unforgettable journey!

Thank you for being a part of our journey. We can't wait to share "Trade Tales" with you!
